title: Finite module supported only at a maximal ideal has finite length
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $M$ be a finite nonzero $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] whose support [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is contained in $\{\mathfrak m\}$. Then $M$ has finite length over $R$; equivalently, $\mathrm{length}_R(M)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length] is a positive natural number.
